purpose: Prospectively resolve the executed PBE Stage A bulk numerical HOLD without weakening any frozen gate, changing the electronic-structure method, rerunning valid archived CO data unnecessarily, or using any kinetic observable.

triggering_stage_a_result.workflow_name: CO Cu111 PBE Stage A recovered adjudication v1
triggering_stage_a_result.cause: No originally selectable bulk cutoff/k pair met the unchanged joint 0.005 A / 0.001 eV-per-atom gate relative to the original C2/k16 terminal holdout. The terminal C2 cases were numerically converged but prospectively non-selectable.

forbidden_inputs: CO/Cu(111) hopping rate or diffusion coefficient

unchanged_electronic_settings.pseudopotential_bundle: unchanged exact Stage A PBE Cu/C/O bundle
unchanged_electronic_settings.solver: unchanged exact Stage A Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x

bulk_extension.fit: quadratic E(a) fit over the unchanged complete six-point lattice grid
bulk_extension.reuse_rule: The three valid archived 90/900 Ry k=12,14,16 EOS cases are immutable candidates in the extension and must not be recomputed.
bulk_extension.new_candidate_rule: Execute every candidate combination not already present in the reused_existing_candidates list. This is 22 new candidate EOS cases.
bulk_extension.reference_audit_rule: The 140/1400 Ry k22 reference must satisfy the unchanged bulk delta-a0 and delta-E0 gates against the separately executed 150/1500 Ry k24 audit before any extension candidate can be selected.
bulk_extension.selection_rule: After the terminal reference passes its independent audit, compare every frozen candidate directly with 140/1400 Ry k22. A candidate must satisfy both unchanged numerical gates and the unchanged broad Cu lattice physical guard. Select the lowest ecutwfc first and then the lowest k mesh. The reference and audit can never select themselves.
bulk_extension.failure_rule: If the reference audit fails or no candidate passes, retain NUMERICAL_HOLD. If the extended reference fails the unchanged Cu bulk physical guard, return PBE_REJECT_BULK_STRUCTURE. Do not weaken a gate or extend again automatically.

conditional_co_combination_check.reason: The original Stage A combined rule requires CO numerical re-evaluation at the final production cutoff. Valid archived CO data must be reused whenever they already cover that cutoff.
conditional_co_combination_check.if_selected_bulk_ecutwfc_ry_equals_90: Reuse the already validated archived C2/L18 and C2/L26 CO scans. Do not recompute them.
conditional_co_combination_check.if_selected_bulk_ecutwfc_ry_exceeds_90: Run only two new fixed CO scans at the selected bulk cutoff: L18 and L26. Do not rerun the full 3x3 CO matrix.
conditional_co_combination_check.fit: same seven-point local quartic fit and every-second-point discretization check as frozen Stage A
conditional_co_combination_check.extended_terminal_rule: At a selected cutoff above 90 Ry, L26 is the non-selectable same-cutoff terminal box for the conditional combination check. L18 must satisfy the unchanged bond and stretch numerical gates relative to L26; both scans must satisfy the unchanged fit-discretization and broad physical guards.
conditional_co_combination_check.failure_rule: Numerical or fit failure retains Stage A HOLD. Failure of the unchanged CO structural or vibrational physical guard rejects PBE and advances to the frozen BLYP pseudopotential-provenance gate.

finalization.inspection_rule: The extension result artifact must be inspected before launching the Cu(111) clean-surface/site-ordering screen.
